turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Of course. Past questions use 'did' + base verb: What did you do last weekend? Did she go to the beach? After 'did', we use the simple verb (go, not went).

Here is your exercise. Make a question with these words:
he / play / football / yesterday
